name: contract-library-fixture-migration
goal: Migrate disposable verification fixtures to the declared test forms without bypassing policy

evidence: Generator commit 5b280466ff enables strict library admission; the shared fixture adds five undeclared units and its synthetic runner omits the greeting outcome, causing existing baseline preparation cases to fail.

Existing baseline preparation checks assumed its first verification succeeded and did not assert the generated fixture contract and executed cases before establishing budgets. Strengthen the existing baseline case and migrate the reusable fixture.
